Our Partners

Join us for the Southampton Running Festival on Sunday 8th August 2027!

In Support of One Community Eastleigh

Enjoy a summer race day in the heart of the city, starting and finishing on the picturesque Southampton Common. The route takes runners through woodland, grassland, ponds, wetlands, lakes and open parkland, offering scenic surroundings and excellent PB potential.

As a designated Site of Special Scientific Interest, Southampton Common creates a distinctive setting for runners, walkers and wildlife enthusiasts.

Race Distance & Start Times

09:30 am - Half Marathon

10:00 am - 10k

10:05 am - 5k

12:00 pm - Junior Race

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Southampton Running Festival!

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Southampton Running Festival event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for the Southampton Running Festival on Sunday 30th May 2027!

In Support of One Community Eastleigh

Start and finish in the picturesque surroundings of Southampton Common, following a scenic route through woodland, grassland, ponds, wetlands, lakes and open parkland in the heart of the city. The late spring setting, fast course and supportive race-day atmosphere make this a brilliant opportunity to chase a personal best or enjoy a memorable run.

Southampton Common is a designated Site of Special Scientific Interest and provides a unique backdrop for running, walking and wildlife watching.

Race Distance & Start Times

09:30 am - Half Marathon

10:00 am - 10k

10:05 am - 5k

12:00 pm - Junior Race

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Southampton Running Festival!

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Southampton Running Festival event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for the Leeds Running Festival on Sunday 30th May 2027!

Make the most of late spring racing with the Leeds Running Festival at Roundhay Park.

With 5K, 10K and Half Marathon distances available, this event is a great opportunity to take on a scenic route through one of the biggest city parks in Europe. Expect a welcoming race-day atmosphere, beautiful park surroundings and a memorable finish.

Whether you’re building towards summer goals or looking for a fun race day with friends, Leeds Running Festival is the perfect event to add to your calendar.

Secure your place today and join us at Roundhay Park this May!

Included in the entry

Unique themed medal

Free race photos

Chip-timed results

Post-race goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to Leeds Running Festival.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Leeds Running Festival event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Our Partners

Join us for Brighton TEN on Sunday 27th June 2027!

Take on a standout summer race day on the South Coast at Brighton TEN.

Choose from the 10K or 10 Mile and enjoy a brilliant running experience by the sea, with the Event Village based at its new location on Hove Lawns. Whether you’re chasing a PB, stepping up to a longer distance or enjoying a summer run with friends, Brighton TEN offers a memorable race-day atmosphere in one of the UK’s most iconic coastal locations.

With two exciting distance options and a lively seafront setting, this is the perfect event to add to your summer running calendar.

Secure your place today and join us in Brighton this June!

Included in the entry

Unique themed medal

Free race photos

Chip-timed results

Post-race goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to BRIGHTON TEN.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your BRIGHTON TEN event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Take On the Marlow Triathlon at Higginson Park on Sunday 11th July 2027

In support of Macmillan Cancer Support

We’re returning to Higginson Park for the Marlow Triathlon on Sunday 11th July 2027, following the success of our event earlier this summer.

Choose from Middle, Olympic or Sprint distances as you swim in the River Thames, ride through rolling hills, and run past beautiful riverside views. This summer edition promises the same electric atmosphere and top-tier racing experience.

Race Details & Start Times

Middle Distance Triathlon - 6:30am

Olympic Triathlon - 8:00am

Sprint Triathlon - 9:30am

Included in the entry

Unique Themed Medal

Free Race Photos

Chip-timed results

Post Race Goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Marlow Triathlon.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Marlow Triathlon event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Take On the Marlow Triathlon at Higginson Park on Sunday 30th May 2027

In support of Macmillan Cancer Support

On Sunday 30th May 2027 the Marlow Triathlon returns for another year. This event offers Middle, Olympic, and Sprint distances ideal for both seasoned athletes and newcomers.

Swim in the River Thames, cycle through the scenic Chiltern countryside, and finish strong with a riverside run across the park. With stunning views and a well-organised setup, it’s a must-do event to kick off your summer season.

Whether you're taking on your first triathlon or chasing a personal best, this event offers Sprint, Olympic, and Middle distances. Each race begins with an open-water swim in the River Thames, followed by scenic bike routes through the rolling Chiltern countryside, and finishes with a run on grassy terrain in the heart of Marlow.

This is your chance to race in one of the most beautiful triathlon locations in the UK. With a riverside start, ride through teh rolling hills, and a buzzing event village, the Marlow Triathlon delivers a memorable challenge for every level of athlete.

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Marlow Triathlon.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Marlow Triathlon event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for the Women’s Run Series London March 5K & 10K on Sunday 14th March 2027!

Celebrate International Women’s Day with an inspiring spring race at the Women’s Run Series London March 5K & 10K.

Taking place around the iconic Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, home of the London 2012 Olympic Games, this event is the perfect way to kickstart the 2027 Women’s Run Series.

Choose from the 5K or 10K and enjoy a supportive, inclusive race-day atmosphere alongside like-minded women. The course is beginner, buggy and wheelchair accessible, making it a brilliant choice whether you’re taking on your first race, returning to running or lining up for your hundredth.

Expect a welcoming event experience, plenty of encouragement and a memorable finish as we come together to celebrate women in running.

Secure your place today and join us in London this March!

Included in the entry:

Unique themed medal

Free race photos

Chip-timed results

Post-race goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Women's Run Series.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Women's Run Series event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for Run Solihull Half Marathon, 5k & Junior Race on Sunday 8th August 2027

With a vibrant event village in Malvern Park in the heart of Solihull, the event features fully road-closed routes and a fantastic race-day atmosphere. The Half Marathon follows an undulating course through Solihull town centre before heading out to the picturesque villages of Knowle, Barston and Eastcote, offering a rewarding challenge with plenty of PB potential.

The 5K provides a shorter, accessible option, while the Junior Race is the perfect opportunity for young runners to experience the excitement of race day.

Post Race Goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Run Solihull Half Marathon, 5k & Junior Race.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Run Solihull event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Why not become a RunThrough member today and save on your race entries across 300+ events nationwide?! With a range of different memberships, there is something for everyone.

  • Up to 100% discount on event entries
  • Exclusive guest passes and 30% off all RunThrough Kit

To explore memberships proceed to checkout with an event in your basket and you will be shown the different tiers of membership options.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Southport Seaside 10k August 2027

10K

£34

Enter Now

Our Partners

Join us for the Southport Seaside 10K on Sunday 1st August 2027!

Take on a fast, flat summer race with excellent PB potential and a welcoming course for beginners. The route follows a partially closed-road circuit, heading out and back along Marine Drive with views of the seafront and Southport Pier before returning along the Promenade to the finish in Princes Park.

With coastal scenery and a speedy course, the Southport Seaside 10K is the perfect addition to your summer race calendar!

Race Distance & Start Times

09:00 am - 10k

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Southport Seaside 10k.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Southport Seaside 10k event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for Run Reigate Half Marathon, 10K, 5K & Kids Race on Sunday 19th September 2027!

In Support of The Brain Tumour Charity

The award-winning Run Reigate returns to Reigate Priory Park for another unforgettable day of running, community spirit and family fun.

Choose from the Half Marathon, 10K, 5K or Kids Race and experience a much-loved annual event known for its fantastic scenery, unbeatable atmosphere and memorable race-day buzz. Whether you are taking on your first event, chasing a new goal or returning to enjoy the local support, Run Reigate offers something for every runner.

The all-day Event Village brings even more to the day, with a wide range of food, drinks, entertainment and activities for runners, supporters and families to enjoy.

The ever-popular Kids Race sells out every year, so make sure the little ones are signed up early.

Secure your place today and join us at Reigate Priory Park in September 2027.

Race Distance & Start Times

09:00 am - 10k

09:15 am - Half Marathon

09:20 am - 5k

12:00 pm - Kids Race Year 1 up to Year 11

13:15 pm - Inclusive Wave

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Run Reigate 5k, 10k, Half Marathon & Kids Race!

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Run Reigate 5k, 10k, Half Marathon & Kids Race event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

This is a partner event. RunThrough memberships can be used for entry; however, once the event sells out, no additional places will be available, including for members. Please note there will be no RunThrough member desk, and member bibs cannot be used at this event.

Our Partners

Join Us for RunThrough Trails South Downs on Sunday 1st August 2027!

Experience one of the UK's most iconic trail running destinations at RunThrough Trails South Downs on Sunday 1st August 2027. Starting from Queen Elizabeth Country Park, you'll take on a spectacular route through the rolling hills, ancient woodland and open chalk downland of the South Downs National Park.

Choose your challenge from 12K, 25K or 50K, with each route showcasing some of the region's finest trails, including sections of the famous South Downs Way. Whether you're stepping into trail running for the first time or preparing for your next ultra-distance adventure, there's a distance to suit every level of runner.

Expect grassy tracks, woodland paths and rewarding climbs that open up to sweeping views across Hampshire and Sussex. Enjoy fast-flowing descents, beautiful countryside and a true escape into nature before returning to the welcoming event village.

With clear waymarking, well-stocked aid stations, supportive marshals and the friendly atmosphere you've come to expect from RunThrough Trails, you'll have everything you need for an unforgettable day on the trails.

Whether you're chasing a new challenge, building confidence on technical terrain or simply looking to explore one of England's most beautiful national parks, RunThrough Trails South Downs promises an incredible trail running experience from start to finish.

Race Distance & Start Times

50k - 08:00

12k - 11:00

Included in the entry

Unique themed medal

Free race photos

Chip-timed results

Post-race goodies

All routes will be marked using trail flags and tags, along with A5 arrows and signage. Our friendly marshals will also be on hand to guide you at major junctions and cheer you all the way to the finish. However, please note with all trail races, routes can be disrupted by many things: the weather, disgruntled walkers and wildlife, to name a few! To keep you safe, we provide the GPX for your race route so you can check you’re on track throughout the race and course correct/self-navigate if necessary.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your RunThrough Trails  South Downs event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Our Partners

Join us for West Cheshire TEN on Sunday 25th July 2027!

Take on a brilliant summer race day at the West Cheshire TEN, starting and finishing at Cheshire County Sports Club just outside Chester city centre.

Choose from the 10K, 10 Mile or Junior Race and enjoy a popular road-closed event through the beautiful Cheshire countryside. Whether you’re chasing a new PB, stepping up your distance or bringing the family along for the Junior Race, this event offers a friendly atmosphere and a memorable morning of running.

With scenic routes, a supportive race-day buzz and a unique medal waiting at the finish, West Cheshire TEN is one to add to your summer running calendar.

Secure your place today and join us in Cheshire this July!

Each mile for the 10mile and each kilometre for the 10k is accurately marked with distance markers, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the West Cheshire TEN.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your West Cheshire TEN event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Our Partners

Join us for the RunThrough USA Long Beach 5K, 10K & Half Marathon on Saturday 3rd April 2027!

Starting from Shoreline Aquatic Park in Long Beach, California, this scenic race offers 5K, 10K and Half Marathon distances along one of LA’s most spectacular coastal locations. With fast routes, beautiful waterfront views and an exciting race-day atmosphere, it is the perfect opportunity to chase a personal best or enjoy a memorable run by the coast.

Each mile is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to Long Beach!

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Long Beach event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Join Us for the Carlisle Half Marathon, 10K & 5K on Sunday 18th July 2027

Experience an exciting day of racing at the Carlisle Half Marathon, 10K & 5K on Sunday 18th July 2027. Set entirely within the grounds of Carlisle Racecourse, this unique event offers a lively atmosphere, fantastic spectator support and a professionally organised race day for runners of all abilities.

Choose from the Half Marathon, 10K or 5K, with each distance following a fully contained multi-lap course that keeps you close to the event village throughout your run. The format creates a brilliant atmosphere, giving supporters plenty of opportunities to cheer you on as you work towards the finish line.

Whether you're chasing a new personal best, stepping up to a new distance or taking part in your first organised race, you'll enjoy a welcoming event with accurately measured routes, chip timing, clear course marking and supportive marshals from start to finish.

With a vibrant race-day atmosphere and one of Cumbria's most recognisable sporting venues as the backdrop, the Carlisle Half Marathon, 10K & 5K is the perfect way to enjoy a summer day of running.

Secure your place today and join us at Carlisle Racecourse this July.

Whether you're local or visiting from afar, the Carlisle Half Marathon,10K & 5K offers an inspiring route, a piece of history, and a community-driven experience not to be missed. Sign up today and be part of this exciting summer race!

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Carlisle Half Marathon, 10k & 5k.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Carlisle event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

We can't wait to welcome you to the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for the Battersleigh 5K, 10K & Half Marathon on Saturday 12th December 2026!

Finish the year with a memorable winter race at Battersleigh 5K, 10K & Half Marathon.

Blending scenic surroundings with a straightforward route and an uplifting finish on the track, this December event is a brilliant way to round off your running calendar. Choose from the 5K, 10K or Half Marathon and enjoy a supportive evening atmosphere with your running mates.

Whether you’re chasing one final PB of the year, taking on a festive challenge or simply looking to enjoy the buzz of race day, Battersleigh offers a welcoming setting for runners of all abilities.

Secure your place today and join us this December.

Our Partners

Join Us for the Edinburgh Running Festival on Sunday 1st August 2027!

Experience one of Scotland's most spectacular race days at the Edinburgh Running Festival on Sunday 1st August 2027. Choose from a Half Marathon, 10K or 5K and take on a stunning fully road-closed route through the iconic Holyrood Park.

Run beneath the towering Arthur's Seat and the dramatic Salisbury Crags, with sweeping views across Edinburgh's historic skyline throughout your race. The undulating course offers a rewarding challenge for runners of all abilities, whether you're chasing a personal best or simply soaking up the atmosphere in one of the UK's most breathtaking running locations.

Whether you're visiting Edinburgh for the first time or returning to race through one of Scotland's most iconic landscapes, the Edinburgh Running Festival offers an unforgettable running experience.

Secure your place today and experience Edinburgh like never before.

Each kilometre or mile  is accurately marked with distance flags, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Edinburgh Running Festival.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Edinburgh Running Festival event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Our Partners

Join us for the Windsor Trail Run on Sunday 28th November 2027!

In Support of Brain Research UK

Round off your autumn running calendar with a scenic trail run through Windsor.

Choose from the 10K or Half Marathon and take on a flat trail course through Alexandra Gardens, with Windsor Castle towering in the distance. With crisp November surroundings, supportive race-day energy and a route suited to runners of all abilities, this is a brilliant late-season challenge.

Enjoy the historic views, the welcoming atmosphere and a memorable finish in one of the UK’s most iconic running locations.

Secure your place today and join us in Windsor this November!

Unique Themed Medal

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Windsor Trail Half Marathon & 10k.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Windsor Trail Half Marathon & 10k event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for the Windsor Trail Run on Sunday 4th April 2027!

In Support of Brain Research UK

Step into spring with a beautiful trail run through one of the UK’s most historic locations.

Choose from the 10K or Half Marathon and enjoy a flat trail course through Alexandra Gardens, with Windsor Castle providing a stunning backdrop along the way. Whether you’re taking on your first trail event, stepping up your distance or looking for a memorable spring race, Windsor Trail Run is a brilliant choice.

Expect scenic paths, a welcoming atmosphere and a finish line to remember.

Secure your place today and join us in Windsor this April!

Free Race Photos

Chip-timed results

Post Race Goodies

Unique Themed Medal

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Windsor Trail Half Marathon & 10k.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Windsor Trail Half Marathon & 10k event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for the Windsor Trail Run on Sunday 31st January 2027!

In Support of Brain Research UK

Start your 2027 running year with a scenic winter trail run through Windsor.

Offering 10K and Half Marathon distances, the Windsor Trail Run takes you along the beautifully kept paths of Alexandra Gardens, with Windsor Castle towering in the distance. The flat trail course is ideal for runners of all abilities, whether you’re chasing an early-year goal, building your fitness or enjoying a crisp winter race day.

Take in the historic surroundings, enjoy the supportive atmosphere and cross the finish line in one of the UK’s most scenic running locations.

Secure your place today and join us in Windsor this January!

Post Race Goodies

Unique Themed Medal

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Windsor Trail Half Marathon & 10k.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Windsor Trail Half Marathon & 10k event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for the Windsor Trail Run on Sunday 29th August 2027!

In Support of Brain Research UK

Make the most of the summer bank holiday weekend with a scenic run through Windsor.

The Windsor Trail Run offers 10K and Half Marathon distances on a flat trail course through the beautifully kept paths of Alexandra Gardens, with views towards the iconic Windsor Castle. It’s the perfect event for runners of all abilities looking to enjoy a late-summer challenge in a standout location.

Take in the sights, soak up the atmosphere and enjoy a memorable race day in one of the UK’s most historic settings.

Secure your place today and join us in Windsor this August!

Free Race Photos

Chip-timed results

Post Race Goodies

Unique Themed Medal

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Windsor Trail Half Marathon & 10k.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Windsor Trail Half Marathon & 10k event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Run Alton Towers 5k, 10K & Junior Race on 14th November 2026

Join us at the UK’s biggest theme park for a brilliant morning of racing and rides. The Run Alton Towers 5k, 10K and Junior Race take you on a unique route inside Alton Towers Resort, with a finish you will remember and theme park entry included in every place. Celebrate your run with a full day of fun on the rides after you cross the line.

Set on smooth, fully marked paths within the resort, the course is designed for flow and enjoyment. Expect clear signage with KM flags and mile markers, friendly marshals at key points, and a lively event village atmosphere to keep the energy high from start to finish.

Race Start Times

10:00 - 10k starts

10:20 - 5k starts

11:30 - Junior race starts

Included in the entry

Unique themed medal

Free race photos

Chip-timed results

Post-race goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to Run Alton Towers 5k, 10K & Junior Race.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Run Alton Towers 5k, 10K & Junior Race event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Trail Running Workshop September 2026

- RunThrough UK September 2026

Workshop

£95

Enter Now

Our Partners

Join us for the Trail Running Workshop on Saturday 19th September 2026!

Level up your trail running skills with a full-day workshop designed to help you build confidence, improve technique and feel more prepared on the trails.

The day will begin with a coached running session focused on uphill and downhill running techniques, giving you the chance to put your skills into practice out on the trails. You’ll then move into educational sessions covering GPX and map-reading skills, route planning with your watch and training strategies specific to trail running.

Throughout the day, expert coaches will guide you through each session, helping you understand how to apply what you learn to your own running journey and build a stronger, more efficient trail running body.

Ticket Selling

Early Bird Offer: £95 until 19th August 2026

Standard Entry: £110 after 19th August 2026

Secure your place today and join us for a practical, confidence-building day on the trails.

Our Partners

Join us for the London Running Festival on Sunday 6th December 2026!

Celebrate the festive season with a road-closed race day at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park for the London Running Festival.

Choose from a FREE 5K, with around 500 places available, or take on the paid 10K or Half Marathon distances through one of London’s most iconic sporting venues.

For the first time, the event village will be based at Hopkins Meadow in North Park, creating a brilliant festive race-day hub for runners and supporters. The routes will take runners past some of Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park’s standout landmarks, including the VeloPark, Copper Box Arena, Aquatics Centre, London Stadium, London Community Track, South Park and North Park.

With fully road-closed routes, a fantastic atmosphere and a festive feel throughout, this is the perfect way to round off your 2026 running calendar.

Secure your place today and join us at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park this December!

Ticket Selling

Super Early Bird entry - Ends Sunday 4th October 2026

Early Bird entry - Ends Sunday 29th December 2026

Free RunThrough Foundation 5K Ballot

Entry to the free RunThrough Foundation 5K is by ballot due to expected high demand.

In 2025, over 50,000 people applied for 6,000 places in the Foundation 10K, so the ballot helps keep entry genuinely accessible rather than becoming a race to click first.

A proportion of places will be prioritised for first-time runners and people from lower income areas, in line with the RunThrough Foundation’s mission to break down barriers to entry.

There will be three ballot waves:

Ballot Wave 1

Closes: 30th August 2026

Announced: 3rd September 2026

Ballot Wave 2

Closes: 25th October 2026

Announced: 5th November 2026

Ballot Wave 3

Closes: 22nd November 2026

Announced: 26th November 2026

Entering the ballot does not automatically enter you into the event. After each ballot wave, we will contact applicants with the outcome. If you are successful, you will need to accept your place. Any places not accepted will be passed on to another applicant.

Only one application per email address will be accepted. Multiple entries under the same email address will not be processed.

Our Partners

Join us for RunThrough Trails Ultra Trail Morzine-Avoriaz on Saturday 19th June 2027!

Take on an unforgettable Alpine trail running experience in the heart of the French Alps with RunThrough Trails Ultra Trail Morzine-Avoriaz, part of the RunThrough Trails Global Series.

Set within the breathtaking Portes du Soleil region, the routes showcase the very best of Morzine-Avoriaz, from established village trails and forest paths to high Alpine terrain and sweeping mountain views. Runners will pass through beech and fir forests, alongside lakes and out above the treeline, taking on a mix of fast-flowing tracks, technical climbs and rewarding descents.

Choose from 25K, 50K or 100K distances, each offering a unique challenge across the eastern side of the Morzine Valley and through Avoriaz.

Whether you’re stepping into Alpine trail running or taking on your next ultra challenge, Ultra Trail Morzine-Avoriaz offers an incredible setting, challenging terrain and a race-day experience to remember.

Secure your place today and discover the trails of Morzine-Avoriaz!

Our Partners

Run Reigate 5k, 10k, Half Marathon & Kids Race 20th September 2026

In Support of The Brain Tumour Charity

The award-winning Run Reigate Half Marathon, 10K, 5K and Kids Race will be back on Sunday 20 September 2026 in Reigate Priory Park.  Entries are now open.

Sponsored by Simply Sports, this much loved sell-out annual running and community event guarantees you fantastic scenery, an unbeatable atmosphere and a memorable experience.

Our huge all day Event Village has something for everyone with a wide range of top notch food, drinks, entertainment and activities – don’t miss it.

Whether you’re a beginner, a seasoned runner or a veteran Run Reigate runner who loves the local scenery, fresh air and a fantastic buzz, Run Reigate is our much loved community event. The ever popular Kids Race sells out every year so make sure you get the little ones signed up early.

Race Distance & Start Times

09:00 am - 10k

09:15 am - Half Marathon

09:20 am - 5k

12:00 pm - Kids Race Year 1 up to Year 11

Race Ends

13:00 pm

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Run Reigate 5k, 10k, Half Marathon & Kids Race!

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Run Reigate 5k, 10k, Half Marathon & Kids Race event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

This is a partner event. RunThrough memberships can be used for entry; however, once the event sells out, no additional places will be available, including for members. Please note there will be no RunThrough member desk, and member bibs cannot be used at this event.

Join us at Loughborough Training Night August 2026

Training Night

£0

Enter Now

Our Partners

Join us for the Loughborough Training Night on Friday 28th August 2026!

Take your training to the next level with a free coach-led session at the Paula Radcliffe Athletics Stadium, Loughborough University, delivered by our experienced RunThrough Coaches.

This structured track session is designed to support efficiency over shorter distances, helping runners build confidence, improve running mechanics and understand how to apply key endurance training principles. Participants will also take part in guided running drills focused on movement skills, running efficiency and stronger overall performance.

The session will include:

2 x 90 seconds with 90 seconds rest

4 x 60 seconds with 60 seconds rest

4 x 30 seconds with 30 seconds rest

4 x 15 seconds with 15 seconds rest

The focus of the session is training the body to clear lactate at higher intensities, helping you feel stronger, sharper and more efficient when running at faster paces.

Whether you’re looking to improve your speed, refine your form or learn from experienced coaches in a supportive environment, this free Loughborough Training Night is a great opportunity to boost your running.

Secure your free place today and join us on the track in Loughborough.

Join us at Manchester Training Night August 2026

Training Night

£0

Enter Now

Join us for the Manchester Training Night on Tuesday 25th August 2026!

Take your training further with a free coach-led session at Longford Park Stadium, Manchester, delivered by our experienced RunThrough Coaches.

This structured training night is designed to help runners improve endurance, pacing and running efficiency through a pyramid fartlek session, alongside guided running drills focused on movement skills, form and confidence. Our coaches will also share practical insights into the key principles of endurance training and effective pacing.

This pyramid fartlek session is designed to develop aerobic capacity, speed endurance and lactate tolerance by gradually increasing and then decreasing effort durations within one continuous session. It helps runners practise controlled pacing, manage fatigue and maintain good form when working across different intensities.

Whether you’re looking to sharpen your race-day pacing, improve your efficiency or learn from experienced coaches in a supportive environment, this free Manchester Training Night is a great opportunity to boost your running.

Secure your free place today and join us on the track in Manchester.

Our Partners

Join us for the Wolverhampton 10K on Sunday 7th February 2027!

Take on a scenic and one-of-a-kind 10K race through Wolverhampton, starting and finishing at the iconic Molineux Stadium.

This closed-road route gives runners the chance to experience the city in a unique way, with a memorable stadium setting, fantastic local support and a brilliant race-day atmosphere from start to finish.

Whether you’re chasing a new PB, taking on your first 10K or looking for an exciting early-season challenge, the Wolverhampton 10K is the perfect event to add to your 2027 race calendar.

Secure your place today and join us on the start line in Wolverhampton!

Chip Timed Results

Post-race goodies

Free Official Race photos

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Wolverhampton 10k.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Wolverhampton event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for the Newcastle Half Marathon and 10K on Sunday 11th July 2027!

Starting and finishing at Kingston Park Stadium, home of Newcastle Red Bulls Rugby Union, this exciting event is organised in partnership with Newcastle Frontrunners. Choose between the Half Marathon and 10K and take on fully road-closed routes through the scenic country lanes surrounding Newcastle Airport and Dinnington.

Expect a supportive atmosphere, memorable stadium finish and a brilliant summer race day in Newcastle.

Post Race Goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Newcastle Half Marathon & 10k.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Newcastle Half Marathon & 10k event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for Ride Reigate on Sunday 11th July 2027!

In Support of The Brain Tumour Charity

Take on a brilliant summer cycling challenge through the beautiful Surrey and Sussex countryside at Ride Reigate 2027.

With three sportive distances available, this event is perfect for cyclists looking to enjoy scenic rural roads, rolling countryside and a well-supported ride in the heart of the South East. Whether you are taking on your first sportive or returning for a bigger challenge, Ride Reigate offers a memorable day on the bike.

Ride Reigate 2026 | Surrey on Two Wheels 🚴 - YouTube

The 100K route also includes a timed section at Kidd’s Hill, giving riders the chance to test themselves on one of the standout climbs of the course.

Expect a friendly atmosphere, clear route support and a fantastic summer event experience from start to finish.

Secure your place today and join us for Ride Reigate this July.

With Run Series you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the event village and free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what Run Series X RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

Our Partners

Join us for the London Half & 10K presented by TREK on Sunday 28th February 2027!

In Support of Papyrus

Take on an unforgettable late-winter race experience in the heart of East London at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, home of the London 2012 Olympic Games.

Whether you are chasing a new PB, building towards your spring goals or soaking up the historic sporting atmosphere, the London Half & 10K offers a flat, scenic route filled with Olympic legacy.

Runners of all ages and abilities are welcome, with Half Marathon, 10K and Junior race options available.

Post Race Goodies

Celebrate London’s Olympic legacy with every step. Whether it’s your first race or you’re a seasoned runner, the London Half & 10K is a memorable way to kick off your running season. Sign up today and be part of something special!

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the London Half Marathon & 10k Presented by TREK.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your London Half & 10k Presented by TREK event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Morpeth 10k June 2027runningSunday, 27th June, 2027
Sportrunning
DateSunday, 27th June, 2027
LocationMarket Pl, Morpeth NE61 1HG, UK
Start locationMarket Pl, Morpeth NE61 1HG, UK
Finish locationMarket Pl, Morpeth NE61 1HG, UK
Age restriction—
SummaryJoin us for the RunThrough at Morpeth 10k on June 27, 2027. This closed-road 10K race starts and finishes beside Morpeth’s historic clock tower in the Market Place, offering a predominantly flat course through the town and surrounding countryside. It features two 10K waves (A-race sub-40 mins and B-race) plus a junior race.

Our Partners

Join us for the Morpeth 10K & Juniors on Sunday 27th June 2027!

Starting and finishing beside Morpeth’s historic clock tower, this closed-road race offers a brilliant early summer challenge in the heart of Northumberland. The predominantly flat 10K route takes in key landmarks around the town before heading onto a picturesque 2-lap loop through the surrounding countryside.

The course is officially measured, making it a fantastic choice for runners chasing a new PB, while the supportive, community-led atmosphere makes it just as welcoming for those taking on the distance for the first time.

To keep the course flowing comfortably, the 10K will use two start waves. Choose the wave that best matches your expected finish time so you can run alongside others at a similar pace:

10K A-Race: Sub 40 minutes

10K B-Race: Over 40 minutes

The Junior Race gives younger runners the chance to be part of the Morpeth race-day experience, with plenty of support and encouragement from the crowd.

Post-race goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to Morpeth 10k.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Morpeth 10k event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Our Partners

Join us for the East Yorkshire Half Marathon & 10K on Sunday 20th June 2027!

In Support of RSPCA Hull & East Riding

Set against the beautiful backdrop of Burton Constable Hall, this early summer race offers a fast, predominantly flat road course through the scenic East Yorkshire countryside. Runners will pass through the picturesque villages of West Newton and New Ellerby, taking in peaceful rural views and a brilliant race-day atmosphere.

Choose between the Half Marathon or 10K and enjoy closed roads, chip-timed results and plenty of support from start to finish. Whether you are chasing a new PB, stepping up to a new distance or enjoying a summer run through the countryside, this event is a fantastic addition to your 2027 race calendar.

Post-race goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the East Yorkshire Half Marathon & 10K.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your East Yorkshire Half Marathon & 10K event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Our Partners

Join us for the Northwich 10K on Sunday 20th June 2027!

In Support of The Joshua Tree

We're delighted to have The Joshua Tree returning as our Charity of the Year for the Northwich 10k 2027. The Joshua Tree provides bespoke programmes of support to improve the emotional health and wellbeing of families affected by childhood cancers nationwide. Join them at the start line and together we can make a real difference. To sign up to run for them, click here

Take on an exciting 10K race through the heart of Northwich, starting and finishing at Barons Quay in the town centre. With fully closed roads, a lively race day atmosphere, and a rewarding undulating route, this event is a brilliant summer challenge for runners of all abilities.

The course heads out from Northwich town centre before passing the scenic surroundings of Marbury Country Park and continuing through Carey Park. Whether you’re chasing a strong 10K time, taking on your next challenge, or enjoying a memorable race morning with friends, you can expect great support from start to finish.

With chip-timed results, clear course marking, friendly marshals, and a buzzing finish line at Barons Quay, the Northwich 10K offers everything you need for a fantastic race day.

Post Race Goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Northwich 10k.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Northwich 10k event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Our Partners

Join us for the RunThrough Newcastle Town Moor Half Marathon, 10K, 5K & Junior Race on Sunday 21st March 2027!

Take on a fast and flat race through Exhibition Park and Town Moor, right in the heart of Newcastle upon Tyne.

With Newcastle’s skyline as your backdrop and views towards St James’ Park, this scenic city-centre event is perfect for PB chasers, first-timers, club runners and families joining the Junior Race.

Choose from the Half Marathon, 10K, 5K or Junior Race and enjoy a traffic-free parkland route, chip-timed results, supportive marshals and a memorable finish-line experience with a bespoke medal, water and post-race goodies.

Free Race Photos

Chip-timed results

Post Race Goodies

Experience a city centre run like no other with green space beneath your feet and the urban energy of Newcastle all around you.

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Newcastle Town Moor Half Marathon, 10k, 5k & Junior Race.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Newcastle Town Moor Half Marathon, 10k, 5k & Junior Race event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Join us for the Cheltenham Running Festival on Sunday 20th June 2027

Get ready for an unforgettable summer race day at one of the UK’s most iconic sporting venues. The Cheltenham Running Festival returns in 2027, giving runners the chance to take on a 5K, 10K or Half Marathon at the world-famous Cheltenham Racecourse.

Whether you are chasing a new personal best, stepping up to a longer distance or enjoying the atmosphere of a unique race day setting, this event offers a brilliant experience for runners of all abilities.

With a historic venue, supportive race day atmosphere and a choice of distances to suit different goals, the Cheltenham Running Festival is the perfect addition to your 2027 running calendar.

Included in the entry:

Unique themed medal

Free race photos

Chip-timed results

Post-race goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Cheltenham Running Festival.

With RunThrough you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you round the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Cheltenham Running Festival event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event.

We can’t wait to see you on the start line!

Our Partners

Join us for RunThrough Trails Girona on Saturday 3rd April 2027!

Take on a stunning trail-running challenge in the wild and beautiful Les Gavarres Natural Park, Catalonia. RunThrough Trails Girona returns in 2027, offering runners the chance to experience rolling hills, forested ridgelines, fast gravel trails and breathtaking natural scenery just beyond the city of Girona.

The event village will be located at Jardins de les Pedreres, Pujada de la Mercè, creating a memorable race day base close to the heart of Girona before runners head out towards the trails of Les Gavarres Natural Park.

Whether you are stepping into trail running or looking for your next European race adventure, RunThrough Trails Girona offers a rewarding route, a dramatic natural backdrop and a brilliant way to experience one of Catalonia’s most scenic trail-running destinations.

Free Race Photos

Come and enjoy the day with us, we hope to see you there!

All routes will be marked using trail flags and tags, along with A5 arrows and signage. Our friendly marshals will also be on hand to guide you at major junctions and cheer you all the way to the finish. However, please note with all trail races, routes can be disrupted by many things: the weather, disgruntled walkers and wildlife, to name a few! To keep you safe, we provide the GPX for your race route so you can check you’re on track throughout the race and course correct/self-navigate if necessary.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your RunThrough Trails Girona event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Our Partners

Join us for the Battersea Park 5K, 10K and Half Marathon on Saturday 12th September 2026!

Set within one of London’s most picturesque parks, this fast and flat race is a favourite for runners chasing a personal best. With smooth park paths, an easy-to-follow route and a brilliant central London setting, Battersea Park offers the perfect course for runners of all abilities.

Starting and finishing inside the park, each distance gives you the chance to enjoy a well-supported race day with plenty of opportunities for spectators to cheer you on around the course.

Whether you are taking on the 5K, stepping up to the 10K or pushing for a Half Marathon goal, Battersea Park is a fantastic place to race this September.

Race Distance & Start Times

10:30 - Half Marathon

11:15 - 10k

11:11 - 5k

Included in the entry

Unique themed medal

Free race photos

Chip-timed results

Post-race goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to the Battersea Park 5K, 10K and Half Marathon.

You can now grab your Battersea Park 5K, 10K and Half Marathon event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.

Our Partners

Join us for the Leeds Running Festival on Sunday 29th August 2027!

Celebrate the final weeks of summer at the Leeds Running Festival on Sunday 29th August 2027. Taking place in the stunning surroundings of Roundhay Park, one of the largest city parks in Europe, this popular event offers 5K, 10K and Half Marathon distances for runners of all abilities.

Enjoy a scenic route through lakeside paths, woodland trails and open parkland as you make the most of the late-summer atmosphere. Whether you're aiming for a personal best, preparing for an autumn race or simply looking for a memorable day out, Roundhay Park provides the perfect setting for a summer running challenge.

With fantastic event support, a friendly atmosphere and beautiful surroundings throughout the course, the Leeds Running Festival is the ideal way to round off your summer running season.

Post-race goodies

Each kilometre is accurately marked with distance flags, and our friendly marshals will guide and cheer you all the way to the finish. We cannot wait to welcome you to Leeds Running Festival.

With RunThrough, you can expect a friendly team of marshals to help guide you around the course and cheer you on to the finish, a lively and well-serviced event village with plenty of food and drink options, including free goodies from our partners at the finish line after your hard effort.

We have been extensively researching what runners consider important, and sustainability is fast becoming the top issue. Click here to see what RunThrough is doing for sustainability.

You can now grab your Leeds Running Festival event t-shirt for more than 30% off when you buy it as part of your entry on checkout! With the event logo printed on the chest, it’s the perfect keepsake to celebrate your race and wear your achievement with pride!

We can do this with our partner RT Kit as part of a strategic decision to raise awareness about the quality of the product, whilst reducing the overall cost of events for those who would prefer not to have a t-shirt included.

Come and enjoy the day with us. Once you enter, you will receive a confirmation email. More information will be sent closer to the event. We can’t wait to see you on the start line.
